data.title: kadence search: lexical retrieval across the whole journal
data.description: One query over everything in .kadence/ - tasks, their criteria and comments, decisions with their why and rejected alternatives, notes, and documents cut at their headings. BM25, hand-rolled, zero dependencies, over the folded projection rather than the raw event files: labels exist only after folding (I7), the projection is the current state so a superseded decision does not pollute the answer, and it is the same source every other command reads, so search cannot disagree with task show. Measured on the real post-migration corpus: 829 units, 198k tokens, index 45 ms, query 0.44 ms - no persistence needed at this size. Not vectors: an embedding model is 200 MB and seconds of cold start against a 200 ms budget and an offline promise, and on a corpus this full of ULID, KAD-N, I7 and FlowEvent it loses to exact terms anyway. Every hit carries the ULID and never KAD-N, a quoted span with offsets so an agent cites instead of paraphrasing, and the event ts and actor as provenance. Below a score floor the answer is empty and says so: insufficient context makes a model fabricate more than no context does.
